name: Severna Park Showdown 2017

venue.name: Severna Park High School
venue.details: Competition will take place in the cafeteria

information: Registration cost is $15 online.  LUNCH WILL BE PROVIDED FOR ALL COMPETITORS AND GUESTS! Registration at the door will not be allowed. Free for Severna Park High School students. There is a 300 person competitor limit. **This competition will feature raffles for popular cubing products as well as competition t-shirts sold. All proceeds will benefit SPHS Key Club's initiative to help children in need this holiday season.**
